name: Restricted FINZ Max 2048 Text
definition: Specifies a character string with a maximum length of 2048 characters limited to character set Z that is, a-z A-Z / - ? : ( ) . , ‘ += ! “ % & * < > ; @ #  .
format: Required format is 1 to 2048 letters or digits or any of ! " % & * ; < >   . , ( ) \n \r / = ' + : ? @ # { - _
